summary: Frustrated repeat of directive after incomplete response
detailed_context: User issued a clear directive ('Strip them out to match live') in the previous exchange. The AI's prior response was truncated mid-sentence ('📦 D2 in-app read-only ch'), failing to complete the thought or execute the instruction. Now the user is repeating the exact same directive tersely—a classic signal of mild-to-strong frustration. They're having to re-state what should have been understood/actioned. The repetition + terse tone + prior incomplete output indicate dissatisfaction. Next response must fully address the stripping-out task with complete delivery.
